# NeoApps.AI Marketplace

> A curated marketplace design for NeoApps business applications. Ten interactive pilots demonstrate buyer workflows. The accompanying playbook documents 119 proposed apps across seven categories.

Use the category briefs for app-specific build prompts and acceptance tests. Use the PRD for the intended production experience, where a purchase deploys an app into the buyer’s own NeoApps account. Checkout, refunds, sign-in, notifications, and deployment in this static repository are browser-local simulations. Prices are illustrative. The 119 playbook entries describe planned work, including the ten pilot concepts.

## Product and implementation

- [Marketplace product requirements](resources/marketplace-prd.md) — Buyer journey, factory publishing, deployment states, roles, licences, support, and open decisions.
- [Repository guide](README.md) — Local run instructions, sample workflows, and source files.

## App briefs

- [Personal and everyday life](resources/briefs/personal.md) — Briefs 1–15.
- [Team operations and internal tools](resources/briefs/team-operations.md) — Briefs 16–35.
- [Client services, agencies, and consultants](resources/briefs/client-services.md) — Briefs 36–55.
- [Data, research, and AI micro-utilities](resources/briefs/data-research-ai.md) — Briefs 56–75.
- [Education, communities, and events](resources/briefs/education-community.md) — Briefs 76–90.
- [Small business and field operations](resources/briefs/small-business-field-ops.md) — Briefs 91–100.
- [Nonprofit operations](resources/briefs/nonprofits.md) — Briefs 101–119, grouped by fundraising, programs, governance, field operations and live coordination. Each includes role permissions, a build prompt and a test.
- [Nonprofit collection](https://neopric-inc.github.io/NeoApps-Marketplace/#/nonprofits) — Browse all 19 and try the grant reporting and volunteer hours samples.

## Optional

- [Editable marketplace playbook](resources/marketplace-playbook.xlsx) — Launch plan, catalog, builder briefs, marketplace decisions, and variants.
